source: Exact ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS, visible LCD and complete native keys, 2026-11-19
observations: Native PLUS rejects binomial N=0 and Poisson lambda=0 with Argument ERROR. Valid p=0 and p=1 give degenerate probabilities 0/1.
An integer x=-1 returns probability 0 for all four discrete PD/CD types. A fractional x=1.5 is rejected; error Back returns to the first parameter.

Inverse Normal accepts Area=0/1 and returns -9.99e99/+9.99e99, unchanged with mu=10/sigma=2. Sigma=0 is still rejected at an endpoint. Area=0.5 gives 0. Area=1e-20 gives -9.263183155 via the existing calculator seed approximation.
A syntax error in an entered parameter ignores RIGHT and SETTINGS. Back retains 1+; DEL corrects it to 1 and standard normal density returns 0.2419707245.
